query: (filled in from HeartRateService.READINGS_AQL — the query the chart runs)

SELECT c
FROM EHR e[ehr_id/value=$ehrId]
  CONTAINS COMPOSITION c
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  o/archetype_node_id AS archetype,
  o/name/value AS name
FROM EHR e[ehr_id/value=$ehrId]
  CONTAINS OBSERVATION o
LIMIT 10

SELECT
  COUNT(o) AS readings,
  MIN(o/data[at0002]/events[at0003]/data[at0001]/items[at0004]/value/magnitude) AS lowest,
  MAX(o/data[at0002]/events[at0003]/data[at0001]/items[at0004]/value/magnitude) AS highest,
  AVG(o/data[at0002]/events[at0003]/data[at0001]/items[at0004]/value/magnitude) AS mean
FROM EHR e[ehr_id/value=$ehrId]
  CONTAINS OBSERVATION o[openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.pulse.v2]

SELECT
  c/uid/value AS version_uid,
  v/commit_audit/time_committed/value AS committed,
  v/commit_audit/change_type/value AS change,
  o/data[at0002]/events[at0003]/data[at0001]/items[at0004]/value/magnitude AS bpm
FROM EHR e[ehr_id/value=$ehrId]
  CONTAINS VERSION v
    CONTAINS COMPOSITION c
      CONTAINS OBSERVATION o[openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.pulse.v2]
LIMIT 10

SELECT
  o/data[at0002]/events[at0003]/data[at0001]/items[at9999]/value/magnitude AS bpm
FROM EHR e[ehr_id/value=$ehrId]
  CONTAINS OBSERVATION o[openEHR-EHR-OBSERVATION.pulse.v2]
LIMIT 10
